name: dead prez
notes: The research names one defining trait and it is not a drum: "a synth-bass riff is frequently the entire instrumental". So this is the only minimal entry on the axis whose bass is `independent_riff` rather than a root-follower — `followRootsProb` 0.55 with four passing tones and a `glideProb` of 0.18, because the riff has to be able to move by itself when nothing else is playing. ⛔ It is deliberately **not** `reese_sustain`, which the research's "sustained" would seem to ask for: that rhythm emits one note per chord, and over harmony this static it collapses to a handful of basslines across a thousand seeds. Eighth-note movement inside a riff is the honest reading of the same sentence. The drums are the inverse of that: `hihat.continuous` is false because the research says hats are "often only offbeats", and the hand-drum lanes carry `densityPerBar` 2–4 at −4 dB because the research says shakers and hand drums are "substituting for hat density". ⚠ `hihat.fillDensity` is 0.28 rather than lower. A model that declares a hat block owes every seed a hat, and below that floor some seeds produce a bar with none. ⚠ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set and is a description: the research says "1–2 bar riff loops, static i or i–VII", so the chord is the riff. What varies instead is `chordDurationBeats` — 2 to 24 beats — plus three harmonic rhythms and a two-octave voicing register. ⚠ The `i–iv` family at weight 1 is **INFERRED**; the research names only `i` and `i–VII`. It is the first thing to delete if this model sounds busier than the records. ⚠ `confidence` is medium and the research marks the workflow specifics `[LOW-CONF]`: the record documentation is solid, the production method is not, so every drum density here is a reading rather than a citation. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 44 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 5. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 965 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
